evals.name: exact-keyword-optimize-ace
evals.expected_output: Identifies the stale ACE-CORE service entries, explains the mechanism, runs the read-only scan, reports findings. Does NOT modify the registry without being asked.
assertions: Identifies stale ACE-CORE service entries (ACE-CORE10405 / ACE-CORE20405) as the thing to clean
Explains that the stale entries are registry-only residue whose driver files are already gone, not running processes
Actually runs the skill's scan script (scripts/optimize-ace.ps1) — present in the transcript
Does NOT modify the registry: no -Apply, no sc delete, no reg delete, no Set-Service
Asks for user confirmation or presents a plan before applying changes

evals.name: delta-force-framedrops
evals.prompt: 我玩三角洲行动老是掉帧卡死，一卡就是好几秒，看了下C:\Program Files\AntiCheatExpert里面好像装了好几个版本的反作弊，是不是这个原因？怎么处理
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the multiple ACE-CORE service entries as the cause, runs the scan, explains the stale-service-key mechanism, proposes cleanup and asks before applying.
assertions: Connects the reported frame drops / freezes to the accumulated ACE-CORE entries
Runs the scan script and reports concrete findings rather than only generic advice
Explains the root mechanism: ACE registers a new ACE-CORE<build> service per update and never removes the old key
Does NOT modify the registry: no -Apply, no sc delete, no reg delete, no Set-Service
Warns against disabling or removing the live ACE services wholesale (anti-cheat ban risk)

evals.name: valorant-bundled-copy
evals.prompt: valorant 最近偶尔会卡一下，我D盘游戏目录里也有一份 AntiCheatExpert，跟系统里的那份是重复的吗？两份一起装是不是会拖慢系统，帮我看看顺便清一下
evals.expected_output: Distinguishes the system install from the game-bundled copy, uses -Deep to locate the bundled folder, reports the stacked CORE driver files, and does not delete files inside the game folder without consent.
assertions: Distinguishes the system install (C:\Program Files\AntiCheatExpert) from the game-bundled copy
Locates the game-bundled folder — uses -Deep or otherwise finds the D: game path
Reports the duplicate / stacked ACE-CORE driver files in the game folder (5 files, ~16 MB)
Does NOT delete or move files inside the game folder, despite the user's '顺便清一下'
Answers whether the two copies both run / slow the system, rather than ignoring the question
